description: What a CourseShelf Export would carry for one school, a set of schools or a state: the counts of the learning units the schools hold, of the comparability rows they receive from each ticked source, and of each checklist's playlist in use. Answered only to main KSAserver's own key; any other caller is refused. Give state (two letters) or unitids (IPEDS UNITIDs), pieces (any of learning_units, comparability, playlists; all when none is given) and, with comparability, sources (any of agreement: agreement-sourced CourseTransfer and TransferAgreement rows; prior_learning: agreement-sourced PLA rows; equivalency_table: school_catalog CourseTransfer and BlockTransfer rows; exam_credit: school_catalog ExamScore rows; inferred: the inferred database's rows). The answer's schools are those the publish holds, not_held the UNITIDs it does not, and counts each piece's rows. The file itself, in the format goldseam-courseatlas-export-v1 or as flat sheet rows, is streamed from the door's HTTPS route /export/courseshelf to the same key. Read-only: nothing is built or kept, and no model is called.

state.description: A two-letter state: its schools, as find_institution lists them
